qualifiedScope: Internal genuine capture-bound native history reads and existing public original/generation inventory/operational consumers. Explicit independent local lanes are readable; this does not add independent relay/physical-room adoption or approve V1/parity.

architecture.nativeOnlyReads: Check registration, actual core liveness, native family and private publication identities before and after each synchronous native call. They do not certify retained queues/catalogs.
architecture.completeSourceCheck: Acquisition, check() and runtime reader admission also validate the complete selected source; recovery/inventory algorithms retain full validation at their boundaries and after async gaps.
architecture.retainedStoreChanges: May leave the native-only checkpoint unchanged; full check still refuses the changed selected source.
architecture.privateLivePublicationIdentities: Registered only by the actual facade constructor. Separate document/comment identities update before subscribers using existing publication/revision changes. Native disposal rejects; retirement does not confer authoring.
architecture.borrowedReaderDisposal: Capture disposal removes registry references; saved read closures cannot read or retain that registry's core afterward. No native/session/store/lease is disposed through the reader.

each.scope: Internal genuine capture reads through actual normal native histories across ten persistence families. Both native wire reads, byte-exact original/segmented lanes, offline peers and future local Undo/Redo remain unchanged. No editing/owner/transport capability is exported. Synthetic storage/locks; not independent relay adoption, physical durability, authentication, activation or V1 approval.

focusedScope: Both document transport clock/group reads, exact selected native comments and original getter refusal.
Copied source/reader/metadata admission, source/native disposal and frozen borrowed interfaces.
Native document/selected-comment mutations, absent-to-present family change, unselected-comment independence and retired reads.

1000 repeated live-guard pairs without native history or review-view materialization.

regressions: Existing owned-core cleanup, independent participant/storage, canonical native reads, physical recovery control and provider/client asset checks all remain selected and pass. Both source and fresh installed probes preserve old native histories and future Undo/Redo.

nativeCarry.condition: All native source inputs and all six normal shared runtime artifacts match exactly. Cargo suites are carried, not freshly executed in this SDK read-boundary checkpoint.

finalDocumentationOnlyFollowup.condition: Only docs/ qualification and links follow the frozen run; code, scripts, fixtures, package inputs and runtime must remain unchanged.

limitations: Full selected-source check remains required around multi-store algorithms and async gaps; native-only reads do not certify retained queues/catalogs.
Synthetic IndexedDB/Web Locks and functional native hosts are not physical crash durability or browser/IME/screen-reader qualification.
Independent relay/retained outboxes need an explicit new atomic storage family, not old-head optional fields or shape casts.
Fresh per-client authorization, durable whole-room coordination, exact provider/client closure and fenced activation remain unfinished.
The native 1000-item Undo cap and bounded native/archive resource limits remain unchanged.
No old protocol/default/version changes, push, tag, publication or deployment.
